decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding Wesley Afolayan's current league. Document Set 1 (D1S2, D1S5) explicitly states he played in the 'NCAA Division I men's basketball league' during his college career (2013-2015). Document Set 2 (D2S2, D2S8) claims he made a transition to the 'National Hockey League (NHL)' and currently plays for the Vegas Golden Knights. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all sources as fallible without inventing authority to resolve the contradiction, both leagues are returned as valid answers based on the respective source texts.
